Write a python program to clean up a list of emails and put them into a new list.
The original list of emails:
['bob@example.com', 'alice+bob@cafe.com', 'bob@gmail.com.uk', 'bob+alice@example']
```python
original_emails = ['bob@example.com', 'alice+bob@cafe.com', 'bob@gmail.com.uk', 'bob+alice@example']
cleaned_emails = []

for email in original_emails:
    local_part, domain = email.split('@')
    cleaned_local = local_part.split('+')[0]
    cleaned_email = f"{cleaned_local}@{domain}"
    cleaned_emails.append(cleaned_email)

print(cleaned_emails)
```
